div.div: 7 انصاغ quasi-pass. of صَاغَهُ [in all its senses, proper and tropical: meaning It was, or became, melted, and poured forth into a mould; &c.: and in like manner Freytag explains ↓ تصوّغ as used in the book entitled “ Les oiseaux et les fleurs, ” p. 7, meaning “ formatus, fictus fuit; ” but this is app. post classical]. (O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
